g.data-flaw: The magenta FLOOD was never detected, so the headline splits wrongly and loses its colours, and the pixel lettering is set in ordinary faces.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: add a magenta ink mask and a pixel font such as Silkscreen to the shortlists.
